inputs.acceptance_evidence: 10 new tests prove validate() now also detects cardinality violations for cac:InvoiceLine's ID/LineExtensionAmount fields, cac:TaxSubtotal's TaxCategory field, cac:TaxTotal's TaxAmount field, and cac:LegalMonetaryTotal's PayableAmount/TaxExclusiveAmount fields, while correctly never flagging TaxTotal.TaxSubtotal (genuinely minOccurs=0 maxOccurs=UNBOUNDED per the schema, matching the model's own tuple[TaxSubtotal, ...] field), proven as its own dedicated test.

execution_steps: 1. Surveyed model/aggregates.py's classes: Item, InvoiceLine, TaxSubtotal, TaxTotal, LegalMonetaryTotal.

2. Extracted InvoiceLineType's, TaxSubtotalType's, and TaxTotalType's complete field lists with exact minOccurs/maxOccurs directly from the pinned OASIS UBL 2.3 release ZIP (same source as events 216-218). Discovered cac:LegalMonetaryTotal's element declaration uses type MonetaryTotalType, not a 'LegalMonetaryTotalType' complexType -- confirmed directly via the schema's own <xsd:element name="LegalMonetaryTotal" type="MonetaryTotalType"/> declaration rather than assumed from the element name, then extracted MonetaryTotalType's cardinality instead.

3. Deliberately excluded Item from this tick's scope entirely: discovered ItemType's schema has no direct cbc:ID or cbc:CommodityClassification child at all, yet item_of() uses find_all(node, 'ID') and find_all(node, 'CommodityClassification') -- a genuinely separate, deeper, not-yet-investigated correctness question about item_of()'s own field mapping, out of scope for a cardinality-only tick and explicitly flagged rather than silently worked around.

4. Confirmed invoice_line_of()/tax_subtotal_of()/tax_total_of()/legal_monetary_total_of() each receive the element itself directly, matching the established QNAME-matches-element-itself pattern from all prior extensions.

5. Added 4 new QNAME constants, 4 new frozensets (one, TaxSubtotal's own, with an inline comment on TaxCategory's ID being projected but the checked element itself being TaxCategory; TaxTotal's frozenset with an inline comment excluding TaxSubtotal, confirmed genuinely repeatable), and 4 new entries to the existing qname-keyed _CARDINALITY_CHECKED_COMPONENTS dispatch dict.

6. Verified interactively before writing formal tests: a valid LegalMonetaryTotal; a duplicate PayableAmount flagged; a duplicate TaxAmount in TaxTotal flagged; multiple TaxSubtotal under TaxTotal correctly NOT flagged (repeatable); a duplicate InvoiceLine ID flagged; a duplicate TaxCategory under TaxSubtotal flagged -- all 6 cases correct on the first attempt.
7. Ran the full pre-existing ubl suite (912 tests, zero new fixtures) against the extended check to look for false positives before writing a single new test -- all 912 passed unchanged.

8. Wrote 10 formal tests covering InvoiceLine.ID/LineExtensionAmount, TaxSubtotal.TaxCategory, TaxTotal.TaxAmount, TaxTotal.TaxSubtotal's genuine repeatability, and LegalMonetaryTotal.PayableAmount/TaxExclusiveAmount, plus the non-violation counterparts.

9. Ran ruff (clean), the full ubl suite (922 passed, was 912, +10), and the full 6-format regression (3288 passed, was 3278, +10; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.

10. Ran skills-first governance: resolve -> add-python-api (COMPOSE_EXISTING_SKILLS), manifest create --write (sfx-48f0f7253a427552, confirmed as the actually-persisted manifest via ls -t .local/skills-first/manifests/), hand-written receipt YAML, closeout --close -> CLOSE_OK.

11. Also updated SAL-UBL-OBL-788B2748204338B8 (UBL-VALIDATE-001), the cluster's 6th obligation with its own distinct wrapper text (not part of the 5-obligation shared block), to cite the new evidence and the updated 8->12 complexType count, matching the same pattern applied in prior ticks.
